name: Gabler Group AG
summary: Gabler Group AG provides subsea solutions in Germany, European Union, rest of Europe, Asia, the United States, and internationally. The company designs, develops, and produces mast systems, onboard components, and underwater communications for submarines. It also provides north.io, a solution for managing, processing, and analyzing raw underwater sensor data; and develops maritime technologies, such as subsea batteries and seafloor power storage systems, as well as ocean monitoring, including gas sensors, data loggers, and water quality systems.
